# JSPARK AI

> The Sovereign AI Operating System for missions that cannot fail. Built in India. Deployed at national scale.

JSPARK AI builds sovereign intelligence infrastructure for nation-scale operations across Homeland Security, Disaster Management, Critical Infrastructure, Energy, and Defence.

## Core Products

- [OpsUnity AI](https://jspark.ai/products): The sovereign foundation. Agent swarms, quant engines, mathematical models, and language models with no token limits and no external calls.
- [OpsVision](https://jspark.ai/products): Sovereign Operational Intelligence. A domain-agnostic, ontology-driven operational intelligence engine that fuses every asset, event, and signal into one living model of your operation.
- [OpsMind](https://jspark.ai/products): Sovereign Document Intelligence. Reads engineering drawings, schematics, and archives at the level of a domain engineer.
- [OpsUnity Hydra](https://jspark.ai/products): AI Hydrology Model. Forecasts rainfall, floods, flash floods, and rainfall-induced landslides at basin level hours before impact.

## Real-World Deployments

- [Uttar Pradesh 112](https://jspark.ai/case-studies): Operational intelligence layer serving 25 crore people across 75 districts. Misrouted emergency calls cut from 23% to 4%, 46% faster dispatch response.
- [National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) NAFIS](https://jspark.ai/case-studies): Fingerprint intelligence system turning fingerprint matches into offender profiles and pattern dossiers in seconds.
